newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Thomson unit to boost Singapore output.
newsitem.headline: Thomson unit to boost Singapore output.

text.p: A unit of French electronics group Thomson SA said on Wednesday it would spend Singapore $54 million on research and development at its Singapore plant.
Thomson Multimedia Asia Pte Ltd said in a statement the move would enable the company to develop goods like digital video satellite boxes and high-definition television sets.
"Mastering the digital technology is an absolute necessity in all our activities and products," it quoted Gerard Dongois, general manager in product development for Asia, as saying.
